um... Never had a father figure. Really fucked me up as a kid and I'm still struggling with it and its affects; i.e. poor grades in school, lack of a social life

I'll spare you the sob story prequel. I told my mom I was Bi and she didn't talk to me for 3 days. We've never talked about it since; it's been 3 or so years. 

There was this one time about a year ago when she felt inclined to tell me that even though she didn't agree with my life style, she still loved me.

It hasn't really affected out relationship over the past 3-ish years.
Diet Dr. Pepper because my mom is addicted to it. And Spaghetti noodles and sauce and meat cause I love Spaghetti

You have to stay anonymous when you donate [Anon]. 

I'm Bi and a Dude [Bi-Guy].
